description: Overview The LLM Chatbot seamlessly incorporates a LLM-powered and personalized Chatbot into your Power BI reports, allowing users to effortlessly input prompts and receive responses directly within the report. This functionality is especially valuable when you aim to offer your business users a secure and cost-effective way of interacting with LLMs such as ChatGPT, eliminating the requirement for additional frontend hosting. The LLM Chatbot custom visual utilizes the REST API of the respective LLM host provider and the REST API of the Power BI dataset. Modes The visual provides three distinct modes: "General," "File," and "Dataset," where "General" just communicates with the LLM endpoint without adding further context. You can either enable mode-switching for users or set a default mode and hide the selection options for streamlined interactions. Licensing & Pricing Licenses can be conveniently purchased from the AppSource, with license management and automatic invoicing handled in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Support The visual is designed to be very simple and intuitive, typically not raising many questions. However, we are happy to support you along the way and answer any additional questions.
